subject: [PATCH v2 09/10] mm/madvise: make cold and pageout PTE lock ownership explicit

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch makes the ownership of PTE locks explicit in the madvise_lru_pte_range() function, which is responsible for handling page table entries. The previous implementation used a restart label and an out label to map and unmap the PTE table, making it difficult to determine where the lock was held. The patch moves the PTE path into madvise_lru_pte_range(), which takes the lock at the top of each pass and drops it before splitting or rescheduling. This change does not introduce any functional changes but improves code clarity and maintainability.
